scripts.dev: npm run build -w @quba/shared && concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev -w @quba/api" "npm run dev -w @quba/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @quba/shared && npm run build -w @quba/api && npm run build -w @quba/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @quba/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.admin:setup: npm run build -w @quba/shared && npm run admin:setup -w @quba/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @quba/shared && npm run test -w @quba/api
